description: E4: sum-of-exponentials (SOE) history. (a) kernel error and number of modes; (b) work-precision study of the implicit L1 time stepper (full history / SOE, uniform / graded mesh) on the fractional Bloch system of B2; (c) torch residual operator; (d) cost per step for a Dirac momentum chunk (smooth solution, uniform mesh).

solver.timing_protocol: one fresh process per (solver, N); BLAS pinned to one thread; one untimed warm-up solve with min(N, warmup_N) steps; then `repeats` timed solves (`repeats_slow` if a solve takes longer than slow_threshold_s); wall time by time.perf_counter around the solver call only; tracemalloc is NOT active during timing; all nodes are stored in every run
